title: 2018 HMMT November Guts Problem 32
statement:
Over all real numbers \(x\) and \(y\), find the minimum possible value of

\[(x y)^{2}+(x+7)^{2}+(2 y+7)^{2}\]

solutions.text:
Let \(z=2 y, s=x+z, p=x z\). We seek to minimize

\[\begin{aligned}
\left(\frac{x z}{2}\right)^{2}+(x+7)^{2}+(z+7)^{2} & =\frac{p^{2}}{4}+\left(x^{2}+z^{2}\right)+14(x+z)+98 \\
& =\frac{p^{2}}{4}+s^{2}-2 p+14 s+98 \\
& =\left(\frac{p}{2}-2\right)^{2}+(s+7)^{2}+45 \\
& \geq 45
\end{aligned}\]

Equality holds when \(s=-7, p=4\). Since \(s^{2} \geq 4 p\), this system has a real solution for \(x\) and \(z\).
